roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: We are seeking a dedicated Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and safety for our residents and team.In this dual capacity, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff training programs, fostering continuous professional growth, and overseeing all aspects of our infection control program. Your expertise will be crucial in maintaining a healthy and compliant environment, conducting surveillance, and educating staff on best practices.This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced RN to make a significant impact within a supportive and dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or clinical education
Experience in infection prevention and control
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care and infection control
Strong communication and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42 based on experience.

description:

Ability to work occasional weekends as required
A proactive and results-oriented approach with a strong drive for success
salaryOrBonusInfo: Pays well for the right person

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This is an excellent opportunity for a professional looking for flexible, PRN (as-needed) work, allowing you to maintain a work-life balance while making a significant impact on patient recovery.

In this role, you will be responsible for assessing, planning, and implementing individualized treatment programs to help patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. You will work collaboratively with a multidisciplinary team to ensure comprehensive and coordinated care, utilizing your expertise to guide patients through their rehabilitation journey.

This position offers a competitive hourly rate, providing an attractive compensation package for your valuable skills and commitment to patient care.
requirements: Current and valid Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Experience working in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility is preferred
Ability to provide therapy services on a PRN/as-needed basis
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate ranging from $39.00 to $40.00 per hour, based on experience.

description: We are urgently seeking dedicated Full-time Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) to join a leading skilled nursing facility in Gainesville, FL. This is a critical opportunity to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being within a supportive and dynamic environment.As a PTA, you will work closely with licensed Physical Therapists to implement individualized treatment plans, helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. requirements: Valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in Florida
Associate's degree from an accredited PTA program
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation for Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) is $28.00 - $37.00 per hour.

description:
Join a dynamic team of healthcare professionals across multiple outpatient rehabilitation clinics in Brooklyn, NY, as a PM&R Physician. This role offers a unique opportunity to focus exclusively on Workers' Compensation and No-Fault/Lien cases, working within a practice that does not engage with major medical insurances, Medicare, or Medicaid. We are seeking a dedicated physician who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to providing exceptional patient care.

This position comes with a highly attractive compensation package, starting at $300,000+ per year, with a significant emphasis on performance-based bonuses. Candidates must be prepared for weekend work as part of their commitment to patient recovery and clinic operations. If you are a WCB-certified physician with a strong background in workers' compensation, this is an urgent and rewarding opportunity to advance your career.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD/DO) degree and board certification in Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation
Current New York State medical license
WCB (Workers' Compensation Board) certification is required
Minimum of 2 years of experience in Workers' Compensation or No-Fault/Lien cases
Ability to work weekends as needed
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation starts at $300,000+ per year, with a very heavy emphasis on bonuses and less on base salary.
